stem.text: A student has a set of identical cells and identical lamps. The cells have negligible internal resistance.
A lamp connected to a cell lights with normal brightness.

stem.alt: Circuit with one cell connected in series with one lamp in a single loop.

stem.text: What happens when the student connects the lamps and the cells as shown?

stem.alt: Circuit with two cells and three lamps labelled 1, 2 and 3.

A.text: All three lamps light with normal brightness.

B.text: Only lamp 2 lights with normal brightness.

C.text: Only lamps 1 and 3 light with normal brightness.

D.text: None of the lamps light with normal brightness.
